# Study Abroad Nations

> A comprehensive resource for international students seeking scholarships, study abroad opportunities, online education, and career development across global destinations.

Study Abroad Nations provides curated directories and guides for students exploring international education options, including scholarships in Canada and Europe, online degree programs, free courses, and professional certifications. The site aggregates opportunities from platforms like Coursera, Alison, and edX alongside institutional partnerships.

## Key Topics

- Study Abroad
- Scholarships
- Online Education
- Distance Learning
- Financial Aid
- International Students
- Canada
- Europe
- Free Courses
- Certificates
- Online Law Schools
- ABA Accreditation
- Skill Development
- Educational Opportunities
- Bar Exam Preparation

## Study Abroad & Scholarships

- [Study in Canada](https://studyabroadnations.com/study-abroad/study-in-canada): Comprehensive guide to studying in Canada with admissions and scholarships
- [Canadian Scholarships](https://studyabroadnations.com/study-abroad/canadian-scholarships): Directory of Canadian scholarships including athletic and tech opportunities
- [Europe Scholarships](https://studyabroadnations.com/study-abroad/europe-scholarships): European scholarships for masters, PhDs, and international students

## Online Education & Courses

- [Free Online Courses](https://studyabroadnations.com/study-abroad/free-online-courses): Directory of free online courses with certificates and career development
- [Online Colleges](https://studyabroadnations.com/study-abroad/online-colleges): Directory of online colleges including law, cosmetology, and bible schools

## Online Law Schools

- [10 ABA-Approved Online Law Schools 2026](https://studyabroadnations.com/aba-approved-online-law-schools): Directory of ABA-approved online law schools for working professionals
- [15 Cheapest Online Law Schools 2026](https://studyabroadnations.com/cheapest-online-law-schools): Comparison of affordable ABA-accredited online law schools
- [8 Online Law Schools Without LSAT 2026](https://studyabroadnations.com/online-law-schools-without-lsat): Guide to online law schools accepting GRE/GMAT instead of LSAT

## Specialized Online Programs

- [15 Free Bible Schools Online with Certificates 2026](https://studyabroadnations.com/free-bible-schools-online-with-certificates): Guide to 15 free online bible schools offering certificates
- [5 Online Cosmetology Schools with Financial Aid 2026](https://studyabroadnations.com/online-cosmetology-schools-with-financial-aid): Online cosmetology schools offering financial aid and scholarships
- [6 Steps To Obtain A Sports Medicine Degree Online 2026](https://studyabroadnations.com/sports-medicine-degree-online): Step-by-step guide to enrolling in online sports medicine degree programs
